title: B-4: renewal formula ISNULL guards + null carry-forward
expected: Active V14 DerivedPricingRenewals formula wraps all 4 renewal carry-forward operands (Base_Price__c, Prior_Partner_Discount__c, Prior_Discretionary_Discount__c, COLA_Uplift_Percent__c) in ISNULL(...) guards so a renewal line with null priors computes a valid number rather than null/garbage. Carry-forward arm (when COLACalculatedPrice__c not >0) = (Base - PriorPartner - PriorDiscretionary) * (1 + COLA%/100); guarded operands default to 0. For the test line: (71 - 8.52 - 0) * 1.0785 = 67.38.
actual: CONFIRMED resolved at the formula/engine layer. Live retrieve of the sole-active V14 (ExpressionSetVersion 9QMWC00000023eX4AQ IsActive=true) shows DerivedPricingRenewals formula = IF(QuoteTypeText__c='Renewal', IF(COLACalculatedPrice__c>0, COLACalculatedPrice__c, (IF(ISNULL(Base_Price__c),0,Base_Price__c) - IF(ISNULL(Prior_Partner_Discount__c),0,Prior_Partner_Discount__c) - IF(ISNULL(Prior_Discretionary_Discount__c),0,Prior_Discretionary_Discount__c)) * (1 + (IF(ISNULL(COLA_Uplift_Percent__c),0,COLA_Uplift_Percent__c)/100))), NetUnitPrice). All 4 operands ISNULL-guarded. Only the active version carries the guard; the 5 inactive predecessor blocks have the un-guarded (Base - PriorPartner - PriorDiscretionary)*(1+COLA/100). Function is ISNULL (20 precedents in ExpressionSet; BLANKVALUE=0, confirming the review's original BLANKVALUE recommendation was correctly rejected). Live reprice of Draft renewal quote 00780982 / 0Q0WC0000037AKH0A2 (QuoteTypeText__c=Renewal) on line 0QLWC000003cN584AE (which had COLACalculatedPrice__c=null pre-reprice, so the guarded carry-forward arm fires) produced COLACalculatedPrice__c=67.38 = (71-8.52-0)*1.0785 exactly, matching expected. RenewalMaintenancePricingService SOLO test 50/50 pass, 92% coverage. CAVEAT: the committed UnitPrice/NetUnitPrice/ListPrice on the line remain 0 -- this is the separate, still-open SC-3404 structural-exclusion blocker (prehook log: 'Found 0 renewal QLIs from 1 total', InputUnitPrice stays 0.0, line never seeded as a priced node), NOT a B-4 defect. B-4's null-guard fix is correct and complete; the $0 display is owned by SC-3404. No Draft renewal-maint line currently presents an actual null prior (stamp flow populates them), so the guard's null-defaulting is verified structurally (formula text) rather than against a live null operand.
